description: The apex-dispatch ledger event schema. ledger.sh append validates each row's caller-supplied fields against `required` (field -> type) and `enums`, then stamps the fields in `stamped`. Events marked `provenance` are written in-process only (route.py, hooks, shims importing scripts/lib/ledger.py); the ledger.sh CLI refuses them. Types: string, integer, number, boolean, object, array; a trailing '|null' allows null. Extra fields are kept as given.

route.description: route.sh emitted (or, in baseline/shadow mode, computed) a route.

spawn_request.description: pre-agent.sh allowed an Agent/Task spawn for the active route.

spawn.description: subagent-start.sh registered a running subagent (agent_id -> role -> route_id); post-agent.sh may add usage and resolved_model.

worker_run.description: A provider shim (bin/worker-*.sh) finished a run.

verdict.description: A reviewer verdict captured by subagent-stop.sh or a shim result.json, bound to a head.

escalate.description: route.sh escalate chose the next rung of the escalation ladder.

hook_error.description: A hook failed open (unparseable stdin, internal error).

hook_advisory.description: A hook allowed something it noted (e.g. an open route with no progress).

human_gate.description: A human gate was opened or answered (G12, budget exhaustion).

baseline.description: ledger.sh baseline capture: the environment a baseline/shadow comparison is measured against.

decision_shadow.description: An uncalibrated decision-layer answer logged beside the deterministic choice.
